title: A Donkey Talks
textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts
In today’s true Bible lesson we see how 
God protects His people, the Israelites!
Meet a KING, a PROPHET, a DONKEY and an ANGEL of the LORD

God can do anything
God can open people or animals mouths
God can open peoples eyes

TALK TO JESUS
Dear Lord Jesus
Thank you for making the WHOLE earth
Thank you for looking after me
Thank you for looking after my family
Thank you for looking after my friends
Please help me to be kind and say nice things to other
Amen
